scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Welcome. ^ff0000{0}^000000 Member.
The Kafra Corporation will stay with you wherever you go.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉服务员]
欢迎。^ff0000{0}^000000 成员。
无论您前往何处，卡普拉公司都将与您同行。

scripts.text: Use Storage
scripts.translation: 使用仓库

scripts.text: Use Teleport Service
scripts.translation: 使用瞬间移动服务

scripts.text: Rent a Pushcart
scripts.translation: 租赁手推车

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
I'm sorry, but you
need the Novice's
Basic Skill Level 6 to
use the Storage Service.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉服务员]
抱歉，您需要将初心者的基本技能等级提升至6级，才能使用仓库服务。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Here, let me open
your Storage for you.
Thank you for using
the Kafra Service.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉服务员]
来，让我为您打开仓库。
感谢您使用卡普拉服务。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Please choose
your destination.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉服务员]
请选择您的目的地。

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
I'm sorry, but you don't have
enough zeny for the Teleport
Service. The fee to teleport
to {0} is 200 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉服务员]
抱歉，您的泽尼不足以支付瞬间移动服务费用。传送到 {0} 的费用是200泽尼。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
I'm sorry, but the
Pushcart rental service
is only available to Merchants,
Blacksmiths, Master Smiths,
Alchemists, Biochemists,
Mechanics and Geneticists.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉服务员]
抱歉，手推车租赁服务仅对商人、铁匠、高阶铁匠、炼金术士、生物化学家、机匠和遗传学者开放。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
You already have
a Pushcart equipped.
Unfortunately, we can't
rent more than one to
each customer at a time.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉服务员]
您已经装备了手推车。
很遗憾，我们无法同时向同一位顾客出租多辆手推车。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
The Pushcart rental
fee is 800 zeny. Would
you like to rent a Pushcart?
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉服务员]
手推车租赁费用为800泽尼。您想要租赁手推车吗？

scripts.text: Rent a Pushcart.
scripts.translation: 租赁手推车。

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
I'm sorry, but you
don't have enough
zeny to pay the Pushcart
rental fee of 800 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉服务员]
抱歉，您的泽尼不足以支付800泽尼的手推车租赁费用。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
We, here at Kafra Corporation,
are always endeavoring to provide you with the best services. We hope that we meet your adventuring needs and standards of excellence.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉服务员]
我们卡普拉公司始终致力于为您提供最优质的服务。我们希望能够满足您的冒险需求及卓越标准。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
I am instructed to only offer my services to the ^ff0000{0}^000000 Guild. Please try another Kafra Employee around here. Sorry for the inconvenience.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉服务员]
我接到指示，仅向 ^ff0000{0}^000000 公会提供服务。请尝试联系附近的其他卡普拉服务员。给您带来不便，敬请谅解。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I have been waiting for a master to fulfill my destiny.
Brave soul... fate will guide you towards your future...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我一直在等待一位能实现我命运的主人。
勇敢的灵魂……命运将指引你走向未来……

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No matter how much you pester me, I'll still follow my master ^ff0000{1}^000000. Where are the Guardians?! Send these ruffians away right now!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
无论你如何纠缠，我都会追随我的主人 ^ff0000{1}^000000。守卫们在哪里？！立刻把这些暴徒赶走！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Welcome. My honorable master, ^ff0000{1}^000000...
Your humble servent, {2}, is here to serve you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
欢迎。我尊敬的主人，^ff0000{1}^000000……
您卑微的仆人 {2} 在此为您服务。

scripts.text: Castle briefing
scripts.translation: 城堡简报

scripts.text: Invest in commercial growth
scripts.translation: 投资商业发展

scripts.text: Invest in Castle Defenses

scripts.text: Summon Guardian
scripts.translation: 召唤守卫

scripts.translation: 雇佣/解雇卡普拉服务员

scripts.text: Go into Master's room
scripts.translation: 进入主人的房间

汇报完毕，主人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If you invest in commercial growth, the quantity of goods made by the guild will increase. Therfore, if you consider our future, investments will be a necessity.
 
Initially, you are able to invest just once but if you pay more money, you will be able to invest twice.
 
^ff0000The commercial growth level of our Castle is at it's highest, 100%. No more investments are needed. Just as I have expected from a great economist like you, Master.^000000
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如果您投资商业发展，公会生产的商品数量将会增加。因此，考虑到我们的未来，投资是必要的。
 
起初，您只能投资一次，但如果支付更多资金，您可以投资两次。
 
^ff0000我们城堡的商业发展等级已达到最高的100%。不再需要投资。正如我所料，您真是一位伟大的经济学家，主人。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If you invest in commercial growth, the quantity of goods made by the guild will increase. Therfore, if you consider our future, investments will be a necessity.
 
Initially, you are able to invest just once but if you pay more money, you will be able to invest twice.
 
^ff0000You have already invested twice today. You cannot invest any more.^000000 I expect riches of the guild to grow at a high rate.

scripts.text:

Initially, you are able to invest just once but if you pay more money, you will be able to invest twice.
 
You've invested once today... if you wish to invest once more, ^ff0000{1}^000000 more zeny will be needed.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如果您投资商业发展，公会生产的商品数量将会增加。因此，考虑到我们的未来，投资是必要的。
 
起初，您只能投资一次，但如果支付更多资金，您可以投资两次。
 
您今天已经投资了一次……如果您希望再投资一次，则需要额外 ^ff0000{1}^000000 泽尼。

scripts.text: Invest in commercial growth
scripts.translation: 投资商业发展

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm sorry but there is not enough zeny to invest. You will have to try again when you have the funds, Master.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
抱歉，泽尼不足，无法进行投资。当您筹集到资金后，请再来尝试，主人。

scripts.text:
[ {0}]
We finished the investment safely. I expect that our growth level will be increased by tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[ {0}]
我们已安全完成投资。我预计我们的发展等级明天将会提升。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'll do as you bid, my master... There is no hurry. We will do our best.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我会遵从您的命令，我的主人……不必着急。我们会尽力而为。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If you raise Castle Defenses, the durability of Guardians and the Emperium will increase. Therefore, if you consider our coming battles, some investment in this area will be required.
 
Originally you can invest just once but if you pay more money, you can invest twice.
 
^ff0000But the Castle Defense level of our Castle is at it's highest, 100%. No more investments are needed. Just as I have expected from a great strategist like you, Master.^000000
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如果您提升城堡防御，<黑暗搜集者>华丽金属守卫和华丽金属的耐久度将会增加。因此，考虑到即将到来的战斗，在这方面进行一些投资是必要的。
 
原本您只能投资一次，但如果支付更多资金，您可以投资两次。
 
^ff0000但我们城堡的防御等级已达到最高的100%。不再需要投资。正如我所料，您真是一位伟大的战略家，主人。^000000

scripts.translation:
[ {0}]
我们已安全完成投资。我预计我们的城堡防御等级明天将会提升。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'll do as you bid, my master... There is no hurry. We will do our best.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我会遵从您的命令，我的主人……不必着急。我们会尽力而为。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Will you summon a Guardian? It'll be a protector to defend us loyally.
Please select a guardian to defend us.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
您要召唤守卫吗？它将成为忠诚保护我们的守护者。
请选择一名守卫来保卫我们。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Will you summon the chosen guardian? 10,000 zeny are required to summon a Guardian.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
您要召唤选定的守卫吗？召唤守卫需要10,000泽尼。

scripts.text: Summon
scripts.translation: 召唤

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Master, we have not the resources to Summon the Guardian. If you want to accumulate them, you have to learn the Guild skill. We failed to summon the Guardian.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
主人，我们没有资源来召唤守卫。如果您想积累资源，必须学习公会技能。我们未能召唤守卫。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Master, you already have summoned that Guardian. We cannot summon another.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
主人，您已经召唤了该守卫。我们无法再次召唤。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well... I'm sorry but we don't have funds to summon the Guardian. We failed to summon the Guardian.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯……抱歉，我们没有资金来召唤守卫。我们未能召唤守卫。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
We completed the summoning of the Guardian. Our defenses are now increased with it in place.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我们已完成守卫的召唤。有了它的存在，我们的防御力得到了提升。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I did as you ordered. But please remember if you the have money to spare, it'll be better to set it up.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我已按您的命令行事。但请记住，如果您有闲钱，最好将其设置好。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
We are currently hiring a Kafra Employee... Do you want to fire the Kafra Employee?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我们目前正在雇佣一名卡普拉服务员……您想要解雇这名卡普拉服务员吗？

scripts.text: Fire
scripts.translation: 解雇

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[ Hired Kafra Employee ]
I worked so hard... How can you do that, Master?... Please... Please reconsider... Check it again, Master... Please...
scripts.translation:
[受雇的卡普拉服务员]
我工作得如此努力……您怎么能这样，主人？……求求您……请重新考虑……再检查一下，主人……求求您……

scripts.text: Fire
scripts.translation: 解雇

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[ Hired Kafra Employee ]
Oh, my goodness! This is nonsense!
scripts.translation:
[受雇的卡普拉服务员]
哦，天哪！这太荒谬了！

scripts.text:
[ Hired Kafra Employee ]
I'll work hard for you... Thank you!
scripts.translation:
[受雇的卡普拉服务员]
我会为您努力工作的……谢谢！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
She worked hard in my opinion. It was a good decision to keep her.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
在我看来，她工作很努力。留下她是个正确的决定。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
....
I have discharged the Kafra Employee... But... are you unsatisfied with something?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
....
我已解雇了卡普拉服务员……但是……您对某些事情不满意吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Will you contact the kafra Main Office and Hire a Employee for our Castle?
^ff0000 10,000 zeny is required for their services.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
您要联系卡普拉总公司并为我们的城堡雇佣一名员工吗？
^ff0000 他们的服务需要10,000泽尼。

scripts.text: Hire.
scripts.translation: 雇佣。

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Master, we can't hire a Kafra Employee because we don't have a contract with the Kafra Main Office. If you want to obtain a contract with the Kafra Main Office, you will need to learn the Guild skill first.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
主人，因为我们没有与卡普拉总公司签订合同，所以无法雇佣卡普拉服务员。如果您想获得与卡普拉总公司的合同，首先需要学习公会技能。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well... I'm sorry but we don't have enough funds to hire a Kafra Employee.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯……抱歉，我们没有足够的资金来雇佣卡普拉服务员。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
We obtained a contract with the kafra Main Office, and hired a Kafra Employee.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我们获得了与卡普拉总公司的合同，并雇佣了一名卡普拉服务员。

scripts.text:
[ Hired Kafra Employee ]
How do you do? I was dispatched from the Main Office.
I'll do my best to not tarnish the reputation of the Guild.
scripts.translation:
[受雇的卡普拉服务员]
您好。我是从总公司派遣来的。
我会尽力不损害公会的声誉。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The Contract terms of the hired Kafra Employee are for 1 month and after this term, you will need to pay an additional fee.
It will be useful for our members.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
受雇卡普拉服务员的合同期限为1个月，期限过后您需要支付额外费用。
这对我们的成员很有用。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I did as you ordered, but some of our members will be unhappy. It will be better to hire a Kafra Employee quickly.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我已按您的命令行事，但我们的一些成员可能会不高兴。最好尽快雇佣一名卡普拉服务员。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do you want to visit the room where our valuables are stored?
That room is restricted to you... you are the only one with access to it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
您想要进入存放我们贵重物品的房间吗？
那个房间对您限制开放……您是唯一有权进入的人。

scripts.text: Go into Master's room.
scripts.translation: 进入主人的房间。

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'll show you the secret path. Follow me...please.
When you want to return here, please press the secret switch.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我会为您展示秘密通道。请跟我来……
当您想返回这里时，请按动秘密开关。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Goods are produced once a day... if you don't remove them in time, they will not be produced anymore.
Therefore, it will be better if you check up on them from time to time.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
商品每天生产一次……如果您不及时取出，它们将不再生产。
因此，最好时不时检查一下。

scripts.text:
[Ringing Voice]
'Those who overcome an ordeal shows a great deal of bravery... and will find their way to another ordeal.'
scripts.translation:
[回响的声音]
‘克服考验的人展现出巨大的勇气……并将找到通往另一场考验的道路。’

scripts.text:
[Ringing Voice]
'Only the truly brave can take the test.'
scripts.translation:
[回响的声音]
‘只有真正勇敢的人才能接受测试。’
